Item 7A.Quantitative and Qualitative Disclosures About Market Risk45

Item 1. Business

Acme designs and manufactures industrial widgets.

ITEM 7. MANAGEMENT'S DISCUSSION AND ANALYSIS OF FINANCIAL CONDITION AND RESULTS OF OPERATIONS

Fiscal 2025 revenue grew 22% to $560.0 million. Demand recovered in the second half as customer inventories normalised, and we exited the year with a record backlog of $380 million.

Operating income rose to $92.0 million from $66.0 million, reflecting volume leverage and pricing actions taken in early 2025. We expect continued margin expansion in 2026 as the Ohio plant expansion comes online.

Free cash flow was $115.0 million. We reduced long-term debt by $10.0 million and ended the year with $130.0 million of cash.
